# Fable Tour — Iraq

> Private Iraq tours and day trips operated by Fable Tour (Fable Tour in Iraq), a local travel agency based at Baghdad International Airport. Two multi-day heritage programs (7 days from Baghdad; 9 days Basra to Erbil) plus same-day trips from Baghdad, with 4★–5★ hotels and a private guide in English, Russian or Arabic.

شركة Fable Tour — رحلات سياحية خاصة في العراق من بغداد والبصرة وأربيل، مع مرشد خاص يتكلم الإنجليزية والروسية والعربية.

Fable Tour is a local Iraq tour operator and ground service. Tours are private or small-group. International flights and the Iraqi visa are not included; hotels with breakfast, private air-conditioned transport, professional guide, entrance fees, and airport meet & greet are included. Guides speak English, Russian or Arabic. Booking is via WhatsApp; no deposit is required when the guest can obtain an e-visa online. Cancellation is free of charge.

## Multi-day Iraq tours

- [Iraq Heritage Tour — 7 days / 6 nights ($2,500)](https://iraq.fabletour.com/en/#tour-7-days): Starts and ends at Baghdad International Airport. Babylon, Karbala, Najaf, Uruk, Basra, the Marshes, Ur, Samarra, Mosul, Hatra, and Baghdad. $2,500 USD per person in a double room; single supplement US$540. 4★–5★ hotels, breakfast, private transport, guide, entrance fees, airport transfers included.
- [All Iraq, Basra to Erbil — 9 days / 8 nights ($3,400)](https://iraq.fabletour.com/en/#tour-9-days): Arrival Basra airport, departure Erbil airport. Basra, Marshes, Ur, Najaf, Karbala, Babylon, Baghdad, Samarra, Hatra, Mosul, Nimrud, Erbil. $3,400 USD per person in a double room. Includes permits for Hatra and Nimrud. Same inclusions style as the 7-day tour.
- Infants from 1 month to 2 years travel free. Visa assistance available for US$300 when booking a full tour (for nationalities that cannot apply for the e-visa online).

## Day trips from Baghdad

Same-day private car trips; one price for the whole group (includes entrance tickets). Guide speaks Arabic, English and Russian.

- [Baghdad's Holy Shrines](https://iraq.fabletour.com/en/day-trips/baghdad-holy-shrines/): from $100 for the group
- [Aqar Quf Ziggurat](https://iraq.fabletour.com/en/day-trips/aqar-quf/): from $50 for the group
- [Al-Mada'in (Ctesiphon)](https://iraq.fabletour.com/en/day-trips/al-madain-ctesiphon/): from $100 for the group
- [Baghdad Old Town](https://iraq.fabletour.com/en/day-trips/baghdad-old-town/): from $100 for the group
- [Samarra](https://iraq.fabletour.com/en/day-trips/samarra/): from $150 for the group
- [Babylon](https://iraq.fabletour.com/en/day-trips/babylon/): from $200 for the group
- [Babylon, Borsippa, Prophet Job & Dhul-Kifl](https://iraq.fabletour.com/en/day-trips/babylon-borsippa-kifl/): from $220 for the group
- [Kufa, Najaf & Karbala](https://iraq.fabletour.com/en/day-trips/kufa-najaf-karbala/): from $239 for the group
- [Ziggurat of Ur & the Marshes](https://iraq.fabletour.com/en/day-trips/ur-marshes/): from $300 for the group

Arabic root versions of the same day trips: [day-trips/](https://iraq.fabletour.com/day-trips/babylon/)
